fragen.frage: You changed and saved your published workflow. What's still missing?
antworten: “Publish” again, otherwise the old version keeps running
fragen.erklaerung: In n8n the published version runs. Changes only apply after the next “Publish”.

fragen.frage: How do you treat your Telegram bot's token?
antworten: Like a password: only enter it in n8n, never show or pass it on
I post it in the course chat so others can help
It's public, like the bot's name
fragen.erklaerung: Whoever has the token can write through your bot. If it did become known: create a new one with /revoke at BotFather.

fragen.frage: How do you pass a workflow on to someone else?
antworten: As a template of the whole Agent PC – n8n is included then
As a file with “Export JSON”; the other person enters their own credentials
fragen.erklaerung: Templates don't contain n8n (license). The exported file contains the workflow but no tokens.
